column1: # Upstream skills — THE curated set, one manifest for both hosts (parity by construction).
#   Claude Code: install.sh keeps a shallow git checkout of each repo (pulled on session start by
#                mkt-update → live), and mkt-init links each listed skill into the app repo's
#                .claude/skills/ (git-excluded) → only these skills exist, so nothing duplicates.
#   Hermes:      hermes.sh installs each row through the skills hub (`hermes skills update` = live).
# Only the named skills are installed, never a whole pack: every row owns one job in the
# marketing brain (skills/marketing-kit/SKILL.md), and nothing here duplicates a kit skill.
# Deliberately NOT installed (they compete with a kit owner or contradict the stack):
#   marketingskills revops    (HubSpot/Salesforce MQL pipeline → growth-data/growth-optimizer own scoring)
#   rorkai asc-aso-audit (dup of aso), asc-revenuecat-catalog-sync, build/signing skills (app dev, not marketing)
# hosts: both | claude | hermes      trust: community (Hermes scanner decides) | official (--force)

column4: owns (one line — the router's ownership map)
positioning, ICP, messaging → .agents/product-marketing-context.md (the shared context file)
research synthesis, personas, JTBD, voice of customer
strategy, AARRR plan, budget & media planning
multi-perspective strategy review of a plan (Hermes hub can't fetch it yet: SKILL.md names the dir references/advisors, which the bundler rejects)
paid media strategy (search, social, CTV, OOH) — Hermes scanner blocks it; meta-ads covers Hermes
creator strategy: vetting, deal structure, briefs (build → partner-program)
SMS program strategy & copy (send → lifecycle-engine on Telnyx)
cancel flows, save offers, win-back plays (model → growth-optimizer)
WEB upgrade screens & feature gates (app/StoreKit → paywall-optimization)
experiment design: hypothesis, metric, sample size (run → growth-optimizer)
repeatable loops — triggered by events, never a cadence (kit override)
live social listening (Reddit/X/YouTube/HN, last 30 days) (Hermes: blocked by the security scanner per the author's HERMES_SETUP.md; the kit never bypasses it)
app install / UA campaign plans (Meta, TikTok, Google App)
App Store custom product pages (one per creator/ad set)
when to ask for ratings (prompt → mobile-growth)
app subscription retention (grace, billing retry, win-back)
App Store Connect via Apple's API (asc CLI) — the store execution layer
push listing metadata (title, subtitle, keywords, description)
App Store analytics reports (impressions, conversion, sources)
Apple Ads campaigns via the Apple Ads API
